fields.v: (1) probe_refined: probe-and-refine tuning (authors' own; code github.com/asashepard/probe-and-refine-tuning), no version. (2) static_kb: authors' two-layer static knowledge base (tree-sitter structural summary + one-shot LLM generic advice), also the starting point of (1). (3) no_context baseline. Guidance described as an AGENTS.md file; no SDD framework

One natural-language repository guidance file per repository (AGENTS.md), capped at 3,000 characters (~750 tokens): structural layer (hubs, entry points, import relationships), procedural rules, and after refinement repo-specific rules (test paths, subsystem tracing) and quality gates. Mean length static_kb 1,687 chars, probe_refined 2,754 chars. Added lines: procedural 47%, structural 30%, quality gate 23% (104 lines)

Tuning (per repository, 3-5 iterations of ~22 single-shot LLM calls, no agent loop or tools): 1 generate 10 synthetic bug-fix probes (temperature 0.9, deduplicated); 2 attempt a fix per probe; 3 judge each attempt and propose edits; 4 aggregate, merge, cap at 5 edits, apply mechanically and trim to 3,000 chars; stop after two iterations without change. Use: guidance given to a fixed ReAct-style coding agent that resolves the issue; single-shot fallback if no patch within the step budget; patches sanitised and evaluated by the SWE-bench harness
None (fully automatic tuning; guidance not reviewed by humans)
Single artefact (context/guidance file), generated and run with an agent
Not classifiable (repository guidance file without a specification; authors use no SDD terms)
Existing code bases: issue resolution (bug fixes and small feature requests) from GitHub issues

SWE-bench Verified, 500 instances, 12 repositories (Django 231 = 46%; seaborn 2, flask 1); guidance from one pinned commit per repository. Unique probe-refined solves: median patch 5 added lines, 13% multi-file
Open-source Python repositories (django, sympy, sphinx, matplotlib, scikit-learn, astropy, xarray, pytest, pylint, requests, seaborn, flask)

Automatic: official SWE-bench Verified harness; agent logs. Manual/qualitative: categorisation of 104 added guidance lines; reading of 31 unique-solve problem statements; analysis of 43 no_context regressions (who coded not stated)

Criterion: SWE-bench hidden tests (resolve rate); cost only as relative tokens. Agent = authors' ReAct-style bash scaffold (unnamed, released code), 16k effective context, temperature 0. Values: resolve / coverage / precision, mean +- SD of 4 trials at 200 steps unless noted.
- no_context + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 25.5 +- 2.2% / 41.7 +- 2.9% / 61.0 +- 2.6%; fallback 25.6%. Baseline. Quality: does not work (low absolute); cost: N/A (baseline)
- static_kb + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 28.3 +- 1.4% / 50.6 +- 2.3% / 56.0 +- 2.5%; fallback 30.8%. Quality: partly (+2.8 pp vs baseline, p=0.004); cost: not reported
- probe_refined + own scaffold + Qwen3.5-35B-A3B: 33.0 +- 1.8% / 56.2 +- 1.8% / 58.6 +- 1.6%; fallback 14.8%; ~56% more prompt tokens. Quality: works (best, p<0.001); cost: partly (more tokens, plus tuning calls)
- Step-budget runs (single trial, Qwen) resolve at 25/50/100 steps: no_context 24.4/27.6/23.6%; static_kb 21.8/29.8/29.6%; probe_refined 24.2/23.4/30.8%. Probe_refined does not work at 50 steps (below static_kb, p=0.022)
- no_context + own scaffold + NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B (single trial): 28.4% (142). Baseline
- static_kb + own scaffold + Nemotron: 24.6%. Does not work
- probe_refined (Nemotron-tuned) + own scaffold + Nemotron: 27.0% (135); loop degraded (3.8 of 5 iterations). Does not work
- probe_refined (Qwen-tuned, transferred) + own scaffold + Nemotron: 13.2% (66); 324 fallback patches; agent-loop precision 37.9% vs 38.5%. Does not work (collapse); avg 81.0 vs 39.2 steps per instance

Tasks: SWE-bench Verified 500 instances. Configurations: 3 guidance conditions x Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (4 trials at 200 steps; single trials at 25/50/100 steps) and x Nemotron (single trial, plus Qwen-to-Nemotron transfer). Baseline: no_context. Held constant: scaffold, model within experiment, harness, 16k context, 2,048 output tokens per turn, output truncation ~3,000 chars, temperature 0 (0.9 for probes), same hardware; guidance tuned with the consuming model. Acceptance: SWE-bench held-out tests. Repetitions: 4 (main), 1 (others). Human intervention: none. Statistics: mixed-effects logistic regression (instance and trial random effects, n=6,000), per-trial McNemar, Wilson CIs

Qwen, 200 steps: probe_refined 33.0% > static_kb 28.3% > no_context 25.5% in 4/4 trials; mixed-effects OR 2.11 (vs no_context, p<0.001), 1.58 (vs static_kb, p<0.001), static_kb vs no_context OR 1.34 (p=0.004). Gain of 7.5 pp = 2.8 static_kb + 4.7 refinement. Coverage +14.5 pp; precision not significantly different (p=0.119). Unique consistent solves 31 vs 8 (no_context) vs 4 (static_kb); easy core 65, hard core 342. Effect present for Django (27.7/31.2/35.3%) and non-Django (23.5/25.8/30.9%). Budget: all equal at 25 steps; no_context flat; probe_refined only one rising beyond 100 steps. Nemotron: ordering reversed (28.4 > 27.0 > 24.6%); Qwen-tuned guidance collapses Nemotron to 13.2%

Distinguished conditions at 200 steps with 4 trials (consistent ordering, significant); budget and cross-model results single-trial, descriptive. Limitations stated: guidance length confound (refined 63% longer; padding/truncation ablations not run); localization hypothesis not causally tested (file-structure ablation not run); one model able to run the procedure; loop prompts tuned to Qwen; no probe/seed sensitivity analysis; single benchmark with Django concentration; contamination cannot be ruled out; constrained pipeline (16k context) gives low absolute rates

Variance only characterised by 4 trials; lower budgets single trial; length confound open; procedure shown on one model; Nemotron-adapted prompts untested; other scaffolds (summarisation, tree search) may differ; probe sensitivity untested; SWE-bench Verified only, Django 46%; 42% of instances unreachable by guidance. Future: file-structure ablation (highest priority), larger dense model, multi-model tuning, balanced benchmarks
